1580-4871-5670-6273.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6273.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-2738-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-5420-7824.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1987-6573-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-6573-6991.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-6573-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-6573-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1008-1619-2921-4605-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-2921-4605-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-2921-4605-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1322-1368-2033-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-2033-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

6478-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 6 or greater.
6478-7500.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

661-3536-3685-4659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Cheering Fanatic.
661-3536-3685-4659.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Sculpting Steel".
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Cheering Fanatic. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1719-2628-6185-7252.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6185-7252.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2034-4605-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-969-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-969-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

1274-2034-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

372-1922-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-7095.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

719-5853-6798.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-5853-6798.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1399-1606-3457-3664.easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1606-3457-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2593-2608-4499.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

2440-2905-4183-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite
2440-2905-4183-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1750-2793-2981-5131-5261.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1069-2457-3480-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-3480-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-4050-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-4050-5434.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Repeat.

1636-4424-5231-5347.notablePrerequisites: Dog Walker on the battlefield face up.
1636-4424-5231-5347.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dog Walker, adding {R}.
When Dog Walker dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dog Walker from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dog Walker's disguise ability by paying {R/W}{R/W}, turning it face up.
Dog Walker triggers, creating two 1/1 Dog creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Dog, adding {R}.
Repeat.

229-4396-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1328-1849-3259-3294.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached to different creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block the creatures with Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached.
1328-1849-3259-3294.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creatures that have Spellbinder and Breath of Fury attached.
Spellbinder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Exotic Pets without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Exotic Pets, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Fish token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1624-2358.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

339-1995-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-1995-4893.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Jegantha by paying {W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

539-3688-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-3688-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

1049-1283-2034-3413.description:
Tap orrery to cast Jirina.
on ETB create one token.
Sacrifice that token and Jirina to Ashnod's Altar, this will make 2 zombies, sacrifice those zombies for 8 mana total.
Repeat getting more tokens and mana each time.

224-3147-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
